criteria.text: Symptomatic aortic stenosis treated per an FDA-approved indication
criteria.span: TAVR is covered for the treatment of symptomatic aortic valve stenosis when furnished according to a Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved indication

criteria.text: Complete valve and implantation system with FDA PMA
criteria.span: The procedure is furnished with a complete aortic valve and implantation system that has received FDA premarket approval (PMA) for that system's FDA approved indication

criteria.text: Cardiac surgeon and interventional cardiologist each independently examined the patient face to face
criteria.span: independently examined the patient face-to-face, evaluated the patient’s suitability for surgical aortic valve replacement (SAVR), TAVR or medical or palliative therapy

criteria.text: Rationale documented and shared with the heart team
criteria.span: documented and made available to the other heart team members the rationale for their clinical judgment

criteria.text: Interventional cardiologist and cardiac surgeon jointly participate intra-operatively
criteria.span: The heart team's interventional cardiologist(s) and cardiac surgeon(s) must jointly participate in the intra-operative technical aspects of TAVR

criteria.text: Hospital with on-site valve surgery and interventional cardiology programs and post-procedure ICU
criteria.span: On-site heart valve surgery and interventional cardiology programs

criteria.text: Experienced program volumes: >= 50 AVR/yr incl >= 20 TAVR, or >= 100 AVR per 2 yrs incl >= 40 TAVR; >= 2 surgeons, >= 1 IC, >= 300 PCI/yr
criteria.span: ≥ 50 AVRs (TAVR or SAVR) per year including ≥ 20 TAVR procedures in the prior year

criteria.text: Heart team and hospital participate in a national audited registry
criteria.span: The heart team and hospital are participating in a prospective, national, audited registry

criteria.text: Not covered when comorbidities preclude expected benefit
criteria.span: TAVR is not covered for patients in whom existing co-morbidities would preclude the expected benefit from correction of the aortic stenosis

criteria.text: Uses outside the FDA-approved indication covered only within a qualifying clinical study
criteria.span: TAVR is covered for uses that are not expressly listed as an FDA-approved indication when performed within a clinical study
